verses.text: <pb/><e>Abú Nrigo.</e> <pb/><t>N'ob͕u-miri nile ka m'siworo kpọkue Gi, Jehova.</t>
<t>Onye-nwem, ge nti olum:</t> <t>Ka nti-Gi nāṅa kwa nti</t> <t>N'olu nke aririọ-amaram nile.</t>
<t>Ọ buru na I riba ajọ omume nile ama, Ja,</t> <t>Onye-nwe-ayi, ònye gēguzo?</t>
<t>Ma n'aka-Gi ka nb͕aghara di,</t> <t>Ka ewe tua egwu Gi.</t>
<t>Elewom anya Jehova, nkpuru-obim elewo anya,</t> <t>Ọ bu kwa okwu-Ya ka m'chereworo.</t>
<t>Nkpuru-obim nēchere Jehova,</t> <t>Karia ka ndi-nche si echere ututu;</t> <t>E, karia ka ndi-nche si echere ututu.</t>
<t>Israel, chere Jehova:</t> <t>N'ihi na n'aka Jehova ka ebere di,</t> <t>Nb͕aputa riri nne di kwa n'aka-Ya.</t>
<t>Ya onwe-ya gāb͕aputa kwa Israel</t> <t>N'ajọ omume-ya nile.</t>
